names.name: Orchis
names.note: Tuberous orchids collectively (dog-stones, satyrion); only roots described.

cul:220-orchis.text: They are hot and moist in operation, under the dominion of Dame Venus, and provoke lust exceedingly, which, they say, the dried and withered roots do restrain. They are held to kill worms in children; as also, being bruised and applied to the place, to heal the king’s evil.

cul:220-orchis.83: provokes / stirs up / abates venery, bodily lust
